compliance.summary: The article’s GoGloby section promotes agentic AI design and delivery through an integrated engineering system, an offer not listed in the company documents. It also contains outdated product names, unsupported company and author claims, and a CTA that does not use the approved service wording.

llm_problems.title: Agentic engineering delivery offer
llm_problems.issue: The page presents GoGloby as designing and enabling agentic workflows through an integrated engineering system, but the sources describe recruiting and staffing engineers, not delivering agentic AI development services.
llm_problems.fix: Remove or replace the GoGloby service claims with an accurate description of its recruiting or staffing services.
llm_problems.subject: GoGloby services
llm_problems.source_value: US Data & AI Engineers Recruiting and Nearshore Data & AI Engineers Staffing

locations.quote: Senior AI-native engineers embed into SOC and AppSec teams to design agentic workflows within defined queues.
locations.reason: This describes GoGloby engineers designing agentic workflows for security teams as a delivery service.

locations.quote: GoGloby enables agentic AI through its integrated engineering system.
locations.reason: This presents an integrated engineering system as something GoGloby provides.

locations.quote: GoGloby can embed applied AI engineers and use a controlled delivery model.
locations.reason: This offers engineers through a controlled delivery model rather than describing one of the documented services.
